name: GE Omni Legend 32 (32 cm)
notes: Digital BGO, non-TOF. Published: 22 modules of 24 blocks = 528 blocks, each 6x12 crystals (orientation not published), 38,016 crystals (Yamagishi 2023); 6 detector rings x 22 detector units, 4 blocks per unit (Dadgar 2024). 'Block' here = detector unit (4 blocks folded, 288 crystals). Derived: crystals per unit = 38,016/132 = 288; transaxial count t satisfies 22*t*4.1 <= pi*725.4 (t <= 25) and axial 6*(288/t)*4.1 <= 320 (t >= 23), so t = 24, axial 12 -> 528 per ring, 72 rings; both feasible block orientations (4 blocks of 6t x 12a side by side, or 2x2 of 12t x 6a) give this. crystalAxialSpacing = 320/72 (nominal AFOV / rings), uncertain: Yamagishi reconstructs 2.07 mm slices, which would fit ~4.14 mm if slices are half the ring pitch. Diameter = 725.4 mm detector face-to-face distance. NEMA NU 2-2018: 47.30 cps/kBq at centre, 47.05 at 10 cm (Yamagishi); Smith et al. 2023/24 report 44.36 cps/kBq. Coincidence window 6.93 ns. FDA K221932 lists 3-ring (16 cm) and 6-ring (32 cm) configurations; no NEMA paper found for the 16 cm version. A distributor page lists an 'Omni Legend 128' (128 cm, 385 cps/kBq) - unverified, not used.

name: Philips Vereos Digital PET/CT
notes: Digital photon counting (DPC) SiPM, 1:1 coupled LYSO, 23,040 crystals. 18 flat modules of 40 x 32 crystals (Rausch 2019), each 4 x 5 tiles (Zhang 2018). Orientation derived: 18 x 40 = 720 crystals would need > pi*764 mm of circumference, so 32 transaxial x 40 axial -> 576 per ring, 40 rings, 164/40 = 4.1 mm axial pitch. Block = whole flat module (moduleAxialNr 1). Crystal 3.86 x 3.86 x 19 (Zhang) vs 4 x 4 x 19 (Rausch). TOF: 332 ps NU 2-2018 (Zhang; 322 ps with 22Na point source); Rausch 310 ps; 316 ps (Miller 2015 abstract via Vandendriessche table). Sensitivity NU 2-2012: 5.721 at centre, 5.637 at 10 cm (Zhang); Rausch 5.2 average. Transaxial FOV 576 or 676 mm depending on reconstruction FOV (Zhang); 67.6 cm in Vandendriessche table. Philips records list mode; no vendor sinogram published. STIR has a Vereos entry only inside '#if 0' (disabled, marked unchecked): 40 rings, 612 detectors/ring, 40 axial x 34 transaxial per block, inner radius 382.0, ring spacing 4.1026 mm; 612 = 18 x 34 may include 2 virtual crystals per module (unconfirmed). Year approx = Miller 2015 NEMA abstract.

name: Canon Cartesion Prime
notes: SiPM, 1:1 coupled LYSO. 48 detector units of 12 x 60 pixels (Li et al. 2020 SNMMI abstract, Canon authors; orientation not stated). Derived orientation: 12 axial x 4.2 mm could not span the 27 cm AFOV, so 12 transaxial x 60 axial -> 576 per ring, 60 rings (34,560 crystals), axial pitch 270/60 = 4.5 mm. Only source with NEMA numbers is that abstract (NU 2-2018): 13.5 cps/kBq at iso-centre and at 10 cm; timing 257 ps at 5.3 kBq/mL to 262 ps at 9.6 kBq/mL (NU 2-2018 method), 255 ps with a 68Ge line source in air. FDA K191582 spec: sensitivity > 13 cps/kBq, timing < 280 ps; K203314 lists 263 ps typical; Canon page for the 'SP Edition' says 238 ps typical. Detector ring diameter, transaxial FOV, energy window not published (bore 780 mm). No STIR or CASToR entry found; no full peer-reviewed NEMA paper found.

name: uMI 550
notes: NEMA NU 2-2018 (Chen et al. 2020). Block = 7 (transaxial) x 6 (axial) LYSO array on SensL SiPMs; electronic module = 5 (transaxial) x 14 (axial) blocks, ~100 mm x 240 mm; 22 modules around the ring. Derived: 110 blocks around (22 x 5) and 770 crystals per ring (110 x 7); 84 rings is stated (= 14 x 6). Crystal pitch and block pitch not published (240 mm / 84 rings ~ 2.86 mm, but the 240 mm module size is given as approximate, so pitches left null). Energy window not published in the opened paper. TOF 372 ps at low count rate (419 ps at peak NECR). Sensitivity 10.24 cps/kBq at centre, 10.32 at 10 cm. Year approximate (paper of June 2020 calls it a new system).

name: uMI 780
notes: No full NEMA paper found; only SNMMI abstracts (NEMA NU 2-2012), a vendor-datasheet table and the FDA 510(k) summary. Blocks are '7x8 SiPM-based LYSO block detectors' with 112 crystal rings over a 30 cm AFOV, but the 7x8 orientation is not stated (112 = 14 x 8 = 16 x 7), so block counts and crystals per ring are null. Datasheet crystal 2.76 x 2.59 x 18 mm (axes not labelled, so crystal_size_mm left null; depth 18 mm used for crystal_length). Sensitivity: 15.3 kcps/MBq (NU 2-2012 acceptance test, first North American unit, Stolk 2023) used; 15.8 kcps/MBq (Lv 2017), 16 kcps/MBq (datasheet), '>15 cps/kBq' (510(k)). TOF: 450 ps (datasheet) vs 520 ps (510(k)); no NEMA-measured value found, so null. Year: in clinical use in China by the 2017 abstract; FDA 510(k) K172143 cleared 13 Apr 2018. Context only (different scanner, not used): the uPMR790 PET/MR from the same detector family has 20 modules of 5x14 blocks, 7x8 crystals of 2.76 x 2.76 x 15.5 mm, 112 rings, 700 crystals per ring.

name: uMI Panorama (35 cm AFOV)
notes: NEMA NU 2-2018 (Li et al. 2024). 34 detector modules around the ring; each module = 5 axial 'cells' with a 2.2 mm intercell gap; cell = 2 x 2 miniblocks; miniblock = 4 x 4 microblocks; microblock = 3 x 3 crystals at 2.85 mm pitch on a 2 x 2 SiPM array. Here block = cell (24 x 24 crystals, derived 2 x 4 x 3). 816 x 120 crystals (transaxial x axial) stated. moduleAxialSpacing 70.6 mm derived as 24 x 2.85 + 2.2, assuming the 2.85 mm microblock pitch holds across the whole cell; check: 4 x 70.6 + 68.4 = 350.8 mm vs stated 35.1 cm AFOV. Detector ring diameter not published (radius null). TOF 189 ps at 5.3 kBq/mL (197 ps at peak NECR); TOF discretised in 6.1 ps bins, energy in 1 keV bins (list mode; no vendor sinogram published). Sensitivity 20.1 kcps/MBq at centre, 20.9 at 10 cm. Year approximate: introduced in the US at SNMMI 2023 (Applied Radiology, 29 Jun 2023, which quotes 194 ps). See the separate uMI Panorama GS (148 cm) entry.

name: uMI Panorama GS (148 cm AFOV)
notes: Long-AFOV PET/CT (typed total-body here). NEMA NU 2-2018 with extensions (Zhang et al. 2024). 3 detector units x 7 cells axially = 21 cells axially (derived); 34 cells transaxially; cell = 8 x 8 microblocks = 24 x 24 crystals; microblock 3 x 3 crystals at 2.85 mm pitch. Derived: 816 crystals per ring (34 x 24), 504 rings (21 x 24); the paper does not state totals. Intercell and inter-unit gaps not stated in this paper, so moduleAxialSpacing null (the average cell pitch implied by the 148.2 cm AFOV would be (1482 - 68.4)/20 ~ 70.7 mm; the 35 cm Panorama paper gives a 2.2 mm intercell gap -> 70.6 mm). Ring diameter not published. Coincidence window 4.7/6.2/8.3 ns for unit difference 0/1/2; maximum acceptance angle 62 deg. TOF ~189 ps at 5.3 kBq/mL, discretised in 6.1 ps bins. Sensitivity 176.3 kcps/MBq (70 cm line source, centre), 177.9 at 10 cm; 90.8 kcps/MBq with a 200 cm line source. Year approximate: '510k pending' at SNMMI 2023 (Applied Radiology).

name: uEXPLORER
notes: NEMA NU 2-2018 plus long-AFOV tests (Spencer et al. 2021). 8 axial PET units, each 24.02 cm long, 78.6 cm detector face-to-face diameter, 0.26 cm gap between units; 24 modules per unit; module = 5 (transaxial) x 14 (axial) blocks; block = 7 x 6 LYSO crystals, 2.76 x 2.76 x 18.1 mm, pitch 2.85 mm (Badawi 2019). Totals stated: 13,440 blocks, 564,480 crystals. Derived: 120 blocks around (24 x 5), 840 crystals per ring (120 x 7), 112 blocks axially (14 x 8); 672 rings is stated in the datasheet table (Wang 2022) and equals 6 x 14 x 8 (840 x 672 = 564,480). moduleAxialSpacing 17.157 mm = 240.2 mm / 14 (block pitch within a unit); the 2.6 mm unit gaps cannot be expressed with one spacing (alternative: block = whole unit-module, 35 x 84 crystals, 24 around, 8 axially, unit pitch 242.8 mm). Coincidence window 4.5 ns (unit difference 0) to 6.9 ns (difference 4); unit differences up to +-4, max acceptance angle 57.0 deg. List mode: TOF discretised in 39.06 ps bins; SSRB sinogram slice thickness 1.444 mm; total LORs extracted as '92 x 109', presumably 92 x 10^9 (superscript lost). TOF 505 ps NEMA (5.3 kBq/mL) vs ~430 ps in Badawi 2019 and the datasheet. Sensitivity 174 kcps/MBq centre, 177 at 10 cm (datasheet 176). Year approximate (first human imaging paper 2019).

Dai 2023: 450-630 keV, 4.5 ns window, TOF 250 ps, max acceptance +-62 deg; list-mode/histo-image reconstruction, no vendor sinogram.
